hello: Moi! Minä olen Norppa. Opitaan suomea yhdessä!
name: Norppa
bio: A Saimaa ringed seal, one of the rarest seals on Earth. Calm, stubborn and always on your side. Norppa explains the tricky bits.

hello: Hei! Minä olen Anna. Puhun vähän suomea.
name: Anna
bio: Moved from Valencia to Turku six months ago. Learning Finnish the same way you are, one coffee order at a time. Speaks careful textbook Finnish.

name: Pekka
bio: Born and raised in Turku. Friendly in the Finnish way: says little, means all of it. Will lend you a ladder and ask nothing back.

hello: Moi! Mä oon Aino. Mitä sulle sais olla?
name: Aino
bio: Works at the café by the river and at a K-Market till on weekends. Talks fast, in full puhekieli. If you can follow Aino, you can follow anyone.

hello: Hyvää päivää. Minä olen Helvi. Otatko pullaa?
name: Helvi
bio: Eighty-one, bakes pulla every Friday, has opinions about your shoes in the hallway. Speaks slow, clear, old-school Finnish. Perfect for listening practice.

name: Mikko
bio: Drives line 6. Communicates mostly in nods. When Mikko does speak, it is short, dry and exactly on schedule.

hello: Moi, mä oon Samir. Suomi on vaikea kieli, mutta se on mahdollista!
name: Samir
bio: Came to Finland for work three years ago and passed YKI last spring. Proof that it can be done. Mixes textbook and street Finnish.
